lists.name: chiefReactions
lists.note: Settings > Chief > Reactions (a416): whether a tapback on a Chief message can start a turn, and the cheap classifier that decides it. The Chief host reads the keys at each decision; a Chief's engine.json overrides them.

help.text: A reaction you put on a Chief message can start a turn when it asks for one, such as a question mark on a question or a thumbs down on a plan. A cheap model decides first, so a reaction that needs no answer never shows the typing dots. Off, reactions are only noted.

rows.note: Empty uses the Chief's Claude route.

help.text: The agent harness the reaction classifier runs on, for example claude or codex. Empty uses the Chief's Claude route.

rows.note: Claude Haiku, the compactor's model too (Lawrence 2026-10-21: "use claude haiku as the cheap model by default").

help.text: The model that decides whether a reaction starts a turn. Claude Haiku by default: it is fast and cheap.
What the classifier is told when it decides. Empty uses the built-in instructions.
